learning_outcomes.text: Awareness about the necessity of lifelong learning; the ability to access information, keep track of developments in science and technology, and continuously renew oneself.
Knowledge about the standards used in engineering applications.
Understanding the universal and societal impacts of engineering applications on health, environment, and safety, as well as the challenges reflected in the field of engineering in this era.

syllabus_topics: Physical Treatment of Water: Preliminary Mechanical Treatment, Sedimentation
Physical Treatment of Water: Coagulation, Flotation, Filtration
Chemical Properties of Water: Treatment with Chemical Precipitation
Chemical Properties of Water: Treatment through Ion Exchange
Agricultural Irrigation Waters, Swimming Pool Waters
bibliography: Morelli, C.,Basic Principles of Water Treatment, Colarado, USA, 1996.
Yalçın, H. ve Gürü, M.,Su teknolojisi, Palme Yayınları, 2010, Ankara.
